# minimal seed; full enrichment is phase 3

column8: Build external-facing sites on Dataverse; check site visibility (public/private) first.
Environments, DLP for connectors, capacity, tenant isolation.
Canvas and model-driven app maker; sharing rules differ per app type.
Cluster admin for the on-prem data gateway: members and status and who can use which gateway; update the installers before they age out of support.

column4: Environment types and the default trap
column8: Production and sandbox and developer environments have owners and purpose; the default environment is every licensed user's playground and cannot be deleted: route real workloads out of it early.

column7: Power Platform admin center > Environments > Managed
column8: Premium governance layer: sharing limits and usage insights digests and stricter maker controls; activating it makes every app in the environment require premium licensing.

column7: Fabric admin portal > Tenant settings > Publish to web
column8: Anyone on the internet can view a published report: no sign-in. Keep it disabled or scoped to specific security groups and audit existing embed codes when you inherit a tenant.

Community-supported inventory and governance apps built on Power Platform itself: maker activity and orphaned resources and compliance nudges. Needs an environment and licenses of its own plus someone to own it.
Flow maker; run history, owners, connection references.
Tenant settings (the toggle wall: export, publish to web, external sharing).
Fabric workloads: lakehouse, pipelines, OneLake; capacities in the admin portal.
Agent builder; watch sharing, auth mode and DLP for agents.
Classify connectors business/non-business/blocked per environment; the flow-blocked-by-DLP page.

column7: Business units + security roles + teams + column security
column8: The user-cannot-see-records triage: check role privileges, record ownership, business unit, then column security.

column7: Managed vs unmanaged + connection references + environment variables
column8: Deploy managed solutions with connection references and environment variables or the flow breaks on import; the deploy-broke-it classic.
Run history retention is limited; add co-owners before people leave; flows suspend on DLP violation or license loss, not only on errors.
Database/file/log split per environment; over-capacity blocks restores and copies before anything visibly breaks.
